question: What was total revenue year to date?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

question: What is year-to-date revenue versus target, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') / (SELECT sum(target_eur) FROM targets WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') - 1 AS vs_target

question: How much revenue did we make in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2025

question: Which country had the highest revenue year to date?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, sum(s.revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales s JOIN countries c USING (iso3) WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country missed target most in Q3?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT iso3, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT iso3, sum(target_eur) tgt FROM targets WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.country, r.rev - t.tgt AS gap FROM r JOIN t USING (iso3) JOIN countries c USING (iso3) ORDER BY gap LIMIT 1

question: Which product line grew fastest year to date versus the same period last year?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_line, sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') / sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01') - 1 AS growth FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was revenue in the APAC region in Q2?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales s JOIN countries c USING (iso3) WHERE c.region = 'APAC' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-01'

question: List the three countries with the largest gap to target year to date.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT iso3, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT iso3, sum(target_eur) tgt FROM targets WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.country, r.rev - t.tgt AS gap FROM r JOIN t USING (iso3) JOIN countries c USING (iso3) ORDER BY gap LIMIT 3

question: How many countries are below target year to date?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT iso3, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT iso3, sum(target_eur) tgt FROM targets WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS countries_below_target FROM r JOIN t USING (iso3) WHERE r.rev < t.tgt

question: What is the average net price of coronary stents in Germany year to date, and in the same period last year?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') / sum(units) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') AS price_ytd, sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01') / sum(units) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01') AS price_ly FROM sales WHERE iso3 = 'DEU' AND product_id = 'DES'

question: What was our market share in France in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FROM sales WHERE iso3 = 'FRA' AND year(month) = 2025) / (SELECT sum(market_value_eur) FROM market_size WHERE iso3 = 'FRA' AND year = 2025) AS market_share

question: Which country has the most coronary angioplasties per 100,000 inhabitants?
gold_sql: SELECT country, pci_per_100k FROM countries ORDER BY pci_per_100k DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many active accounts did we have in October 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id) AS active_accounts FROM sales WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01' AND revenue_eur > 0

question: How many new accounts have we opened since January 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS new_accounts FROM (SELECT account_id, min(month) AS first_invoice FROM sales GROUP BY 1) WHERE first_invoice >= DATE '2025-01-01'

question: What share of year-to-date revenue comes from new accounts?
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT account_id, min(month) AS first_invoice FROM sales GROUP BY 1) SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE f.first_invoice >= DATE '2025-01-01') / sum(revenue_eur) AS share FROM sales s JOIN f USING (account_id) WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

question: Which account generated the most revenue year to date?
gold_sql: SELECT account_id, sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was revenue from university hospitals year to date?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales s JOIN accounts a USING (account_id) WHERE a.account_type = 'University hospital' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01'

question: By what percentage did revenue change from July 2026 to August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month = DATE '2026-08-01') / sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month = DATE '2026-07-01') - 1 AS change FROM sales

question: How many drug-coated balloons did we sell year to date, and how much did units grow versus the same period last year?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(units) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') AS units_ytd, sum(units) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') / sum(units) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01') - 1 AS growth FROM sales WHERE product_id = 'DCB'

question: Which month of 2025 had the lowest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT month, sum(revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 1

question: What is the full-year 2026 revenue target?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(target_eur) AS target FROM targets WHERE year(month) = 2026

question: How much revenue is still needed in November and December to reach the 2026 target?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(target_eur) FROM targets WHERE year(month) = 2026) - (SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FROM sales WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') AS needed

question: What was the gap to target for Spain in Q2?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FROM sales WHERE iso3 = 'ESP' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-01') - (SELECT sum(target_eur) FROM targets WHERE iso3 = 'ESP' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-01') AS gap

question: In which product line did we miss target the most in France year to date?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT product_id, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE iso3 = 'FRA' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT product_id, sum(target_eur) tgt FROM targets WHERE iso3 = 'FRA' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT p.product_line, r.rev - t.tgt AS gap FROM r JOIN t USING (product_id) JOIN products p USING (product_id) ORDER BY gap LIMIT 1

question: What is the revenue growth of Türkiye year to date versus the same period last year?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01') / sum(revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01') - 1 AS growth FROM sales WHERE iso3 = 'TUR'

question: Which country has the largest estimated market value in 2026?

question: What share of the hospitals that bought from us in 2024 bought nothing in 2025?
gold_sql: WITH a24 AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2024 AND revenue_eur > 0), a25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2025 AND revenue_eur > 0) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a25.account_id IS NULL) / count(*) AS churn_rate FROM a24 LEFT JOIN a25 USING (account_id)

question: Which three hospitals lost the most revenue in the last three months compared with a year earlier?

question: In how many countries is our market share above 10% in 2025?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT iso3, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2025 GROUP BY 1), m AS (SELECT iso3, sum(market_value_eur) mv FROM market_size WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS countries FROM r JOIN m USING (iso3) WHERE rev / mv > 0.10

question: Which product line has our highest market share across all countries in 2025?
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT product_id, sum(revenue_eur) rev FROM sales WHERE year(month) = 2025 GROUP BY 1), m AS (SELECT product_id, sum(market_value_eur) mv FROM market_size WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY 1) SELECT p.product_line, rev / mv AS share FROM r JOIN m USING (product_id) JOIN products p USING (product_id) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
